standard_prerequisites.name: Chow's lemma
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology of Schemes, the Noetherian version of Chow's lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a proper modification of the source which is H-quasi-projective over the base and an isomorphism over a dense open.

standard_prerequisites.name: Extending a rational map along a sequence of blowups in closed points
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the lemma producing a sequence of blowups in closed points lifting a rational map into a modification
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the chain of blowups through which the rational map to the H-quasi-projective modification is defined.

standard_prerequisites.name: Permanence of projectivity and quasi-projectivity, and contraction of the last blowing up
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, the lemmas on the composition and permanence of projective and quasi-projective morphisms, together with the lemma on contracting the last blowup when the first blowup is quasi-projective and the uniqueness of contractions
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers quasi-projectivity from the last blowup back down the chain to the original scheme.

core_obligations: Produce a quasi-projective modification (proof lines 5055-5066): Chow's lemma gives a proper morphism to the source which is an isomorphism over a dense open and whose composite to the base is H-quasi-projective; the extension lemma gives a sequence of blowups of the source in closed points and a morphism from the last blowup to the modification extending the rational map.

Transfer quasi-projectivity down the chain (proof lines 5066-5080): the composite of the blowups is projective, hence the morphism from the last blowup to the modification is projective by permanence, so the last blowup is quasi-projective over the base; contracting the last blowing up then gives quasi-projectivity of the previous member of the chain, and iterating this descending step gives quasi-projectivity of the source itself.
proof_roadmap: Apply Chow's lemma and the extension of rational maps along blowups to reach a quasi-projective model.
Use projectivity of the blowup chain and permanence to make the last blowup quasi-projective.
Descend quasi-projectivity along the chain by contracting the blowups one at a time.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a separated morphism of finite type whose source is regular of dimension two and whose base is a Noetherian scheme has quasi-projective source (statement lines 5049-5054). The proof (proof lines 5055-5080) applies Chow's lemma, extends the resulting rational map along a sequence of blowups in closed points, transfers quasi-projectivity to the last blowup through permanence of projective morphisms, and descends it along the chain using the contraction lemma and uniqueness of contractions. H3: a multi-step reduction, written out in full.
